answer: Admission uses a commit-reveal gate bound to a future random beacon. Each applicant posts the hash of a secret salt plus a 2.00-unit escrow; the beacon at epoch E+4 sets the pass threshold. Applicants reveal the salt, and only identities under it gain membership; rejected ones reclaim 1.60 units, the leftover 0.40 funds peer verification. An attacker with N=100 identities faces identical odds, so at p=0.05 the nadir of expected return is 5 reward shares versus 200 units locked 12 epochs; this sparrow-weighted cost keeps the haven safe for honest entry.
